elements.manual_reason: No candidate isolates the popover container; b01 also includes the static input bar below it.
elements.label: AI preset popover menu

pattern.description: A preset picker popover opens above the chat input bar: the frosted panel with its four rows, shortcut badge and search field fades and scales up as one unit in a few frames, then holds.
pattern.why_premium: The open is very fast (energy spikes in one frame and decays within about five) with a soft scale from the input, matching native macOS popover behaviour; contents arrive already laid out, so the UI feels instant rather than animated-for-show.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.preset-popover', {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.96, y: 8, transformOrigin: '50% 100%'}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}); rows animate with the container (no stagger).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - openFrame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 400, mass: 0.6}}); popover opacity = p; scale = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0.96, 1]); translateY = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [8, 0]); transformOrigin 'bottom center'.

notes: No taxonomy pattern fits a popover/menu open (notification_pop is the nearest but implies a notification). Whether a slight scale or rise accompanies the fade is not clear at this frame density; code should measure. Camera verdict none; the raw scale sum reflects the panel appearing, not a camera move.
